title: Layered config merge with delete/append directives and JSON paths

cases.name: example_1
cases.code:
import json
result = json.dumps(sol.merge_layers([{'db': {'host': 'a', 'ports': [1]}, 'debug': False}, {'db': {'ports+': [2, 3], '-user': None, 'host': 7}, 'debug': {'level': 1}}]))

expected.value: [{"db": {"host": 7, "ports": [1, 2, 3]}, "debug": {"level": 1}}, ["layer 1: delete of missing key at $.db.user", "layer 1: type change at $.db.host: str -> int", "layer 1: type change at $.debug: bool -> dict"]]

cases.name: bool_vs_int_vs_float
cases.code:
import json
result = json.dumps(sol.merge_layers([{'a': 1, 'b': True, 'c': 1.0, 'd': None, 'e': [], 'f': ''}, {'a': True, 'b': 0, 'c': 1, 'd': 0.0, 'e': {}, 'f': None}, {'a': False, 'e': {'k': 1}}]))

expected.value: [{"a": false, "b": 0, "c": 1, "d": 0.0, "e": {"k": 1}, "f": null}, ["layer 1: type change at $.a: int -> bool", "layer 1: type change at $.b: bool -> int", "layer 1: type change at $.c: float -> int", "layer 1: type change at $.d: null -> float", "layer 1: type change at $.e: list -> dict", "layer 1: type change at $.f: str -> null"]]

cases.name: no_mutation_no_aliasing
cases.code:
a = {'d': {'l': [1, {'k': [2]}]}, 'm': [0]}
b = {'d': {'l+': [3], 'n': {'p': [4]}}, 'm': [9]}
import copy
ca, cb = copy.deepcopy(a), copy.deepcopy(b)
m, w = sol.merge_layers([a, b])
m['d']['l'][1]['k'].append(99); m['d']['n']['p'].append(99); m['m'].append(99)
m2, _ = sol.merge_layers([a, b])
result = (a == ca, b == cb, m2['d']['l'][1]['k'], m2['d']['n']['p'], m2['m'], w)
